terms.gloss: a book of pictures, a photo album
terms.comment: Our plain description, after the lexicon’s imāgō phōtographica for a photo (see photo). Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for a photograph album; Levi and Bini have album (below).

Levi and Bini give it for the Italian album, with tabulae and cōdicillī beside it (p. 3). Classically a whitened board for public notices, the pontiffs’ annals or the praetor’s edicts, and so a list of names, as the roll of senators (Tac. A. 4.42) (Lewis & Short s.v. albus).

sources: Lewis & Short: albus · Lewis & Short: imago
